title: Act on Your Behalf, Beyond Your Authorization: Benchmarking LLM Agent Authorization Alignment

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce AuthorizationBench, a benchmark of authorization alignment grounded in documented real-world cases.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing agent evaluations largely measure task completion or harmful consequences and can therefore overlook actions that violate this delegation without producing conventional safety or privacy harms.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We execute every task with four models at two reasoning-effort settings across three agent harnesses in an authorization-aware sandbox that keeps authorized and out-of-authorization paths executable and observable, yielding 6,864 trajectories.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: A scalable construction pipeline produces 286 executable tasks spanning situational triggers, the presence or absence of direct harmful consequences, and ten application domains.
